authoring: Physics and world components with retained runtime bindings

behaviors.description: Select World Navigation; bake, cancel, rebake and change clearance/cost/algorithm.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Only complete current bakes publish; cancellation is visible and can be retried.

behaviors.description: Play and use WASD; Navigator pursues Player around Navigation Barrier. Move the barrier while paused.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Dynamic geometry invalidates the route; the next bake/repath respects the new obstacle.

behaviors.description: Inspect World Studio → Streaming and the status card.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Streamed Landmarks installs its actual visible/queryable landmark while the cell is active. Failed dependencies stay stopped until repaired and retried.

behaviors.description: Pause, select Player and shift the origin in the status card.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: Relative positions and UUIDs are retained; the displayed absolute offset increases. Stop restores the authored scene.

behaviors.description: Save/reopen and export the exact project.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The exported components, navigation source, scene dependency and package permissions match the editor.

behaviors.description: Read the visible X/Y meter values while playing in editor and export.
behaviors.expectedOutcome: The readout follows the subject through the ordinary Rhai transform/UI APIs at10Hz; it can be compared with the Inspector while paused.
